meta.title: About Viesigners: Meet the BG Twins, Founders
meta.description: Who is behind Viesigners? The BG Twins, Charles-Erick and Jean-François, lead every project themselves: background, key facts and recognition.

sections.tag: About Viesigners: a founder-led UX/UI agency
sections.h1: Work directly with the two experts who make *growth feel almost unfair*
sections.lead: Viesigners is Charles-Erick and Jean-François BG, The BG Twins. They bring 30+ combined years in UX/UI and conversion rate optimization, and have advised more than 600 businesses, including giants like Disney, Marvel, Hasbro and Dell.

brief.t: service businesses, SaaS and app teams that want a senior partner, not a go-between.
direct access to the founders, with no middleman.
UX/UI and CRO — every decision aims at more inquiries, sales and loyalty.

sections.text: A unique approach that unites *customer experience* and *web business strategy*
prose: We keep our team small by choice: you work directly with the experts, not with an inexperienced employee, and never feel like a number.
after: Surrounded by a network of select digital experts, as human as they are skilled, we act as business advisors, strategic consultants, senior freelancers and delivery partners in designing offers and digital experiences, in order to:
checks: **[Improve landing pages and sales journeys](@landing-pages)** to increase inquiries, appointments and calls
**[Clarify and craft compelling offers](@coaching)** that immediately prompt customers to act
**[Simplify onboarding and the experience](@design-produit)** of apps and services to increase loyalty and extend customer lifetime

sections.lead: Two brothers, one obsession: reducing the friction between a quality offer and the people who need it.

items.name: Charles-Erick BG
items.role: Co-founder · Latte art lover & father of one
items.text: Hybrid expert in UX/UI and conversion rate optimization, Charles-Erick designs the strategy that connects your offer, your content and your digital experience to your business goals.
items.claim: Interfaces and digital experiences that *free up teams and win over investors*.
items.proof: Has advised Dell, HP, Salesforce and 400+ more companies; helped secure $320M+ in funding for an international scale-up.

items.name: Jean-François BG
items.text: A hybrid expert in UX/UI and conversion optimization, Jean-François designs every step of the journey, from the first click to long-term retention.
items.claim: Websites, funnels, SaaS and apps that get more users to *activate, convert and stay*.
items.proof: Top 3% of the world's web experts (Toptal).

items.v: Charles-Erick and Jean-François BG — Masters of web experience design (2009).

[UX/UI and SaaS product design](@design-produit), [websites](@sites-web), [landing pages and sales funnels](@landing-pages), [copywriting](@copywriting), [web business advisory](@coaching) and conversion rate optimization (CRO).
More than 30 business fields, in French and English, with clients in more than 29 countries.
Projects recognized by Awwwards, OCTAS, Osentreprendre and Gartner.

sections.p: Tell us where you are; we'll honestly tell you whether we can help.

a: Viesigners was founded by [Charles-Erick](@cebg) and [Jean-François BG](https://www.toptal.com/designers/resume/jean-francois-b-g#XAEE74), also known as The BG Twins. They lead every project themselves.

faq.q: Where can I see examples of the founders' work?
a: [Charles-Erick's profile](@cebg) presents his case studies and projects, and [Jean-François's Toptal profile](https://www.toptal.com/designers/resume/jean-francois-b-g#XAEE74) presents his.
